mainEntity.name: Is Garage Keepers Insurance the same as General Liability Insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. General liability insurance covers injuries or property damage caused by your business operations, but it does not protect customer vehicles in your possession. Garage keepers insurance fills this gap by specifically covering damage to customer cars while under your care.
